title: Operation “ScopeCreep”: Russian-speaking malware development
summary: OpenAI banned Russian-language accounts using AI to build malware, refine loaders, and troubleshoot cyber tooling.
body: OpenAI banned Russian-language accounts using AI to build malware, refine loaders, and troubleshoot cyber tooling.
summaryZh: OpenAI打击了名为“ScopeCreep”的俄语网络威胁账号，该集群利用大模型辅助生成、优化加载器以及调试各类网络攻击工具。原始信息显示：OpenAI banned Russian-language accounts using AI to build malware, refine loaders, and troubleshoot cyber tooling.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Operation “ScopeCreep”: Russian-speaking malware development”。其重要性主要体现在：详细披露了恶意团伙利用大模型编写和优化恶意软件的代码安全事件。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
